/bin/bash -lc 'research_tmp=$(find "${TMPDIR%/}" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '"'slb-jaipur.*' | sort | tail -1)
queries=(
'site:*.edu.in \"Mahila Mahavidyalaya\" Jaipur'
'site:*.ac.in \"Mahila Mahavidyalaya\" Jaipur'
'site:*.in \"Lal Bahadur\" Mahila Jaipur college'
'site:rajasthan.gov.in \"Lal Bahadur\" Mahila college Jaipur'
'site:uniraj.ac.in college list Jaipur Mahila'
)
i=0
for q in \""'${queries[@]}"; do
  i=$((i+1)); enc=$(printf '"'%s' \""'$q" | jq -sRr @uri)
  curl --insecure -L --max-time 25 -A '"'Mozilla/5.0' \"https://www.bing.com/search?format=rss&q="'$enc" -o "$research_tmp/site-$i.xml"
  printf '"'\\n--- QUERY %s: %s ---\\n' \""'$i" "$q"
  rg -o -i '"'<title>["'^<]+|<link>[''^<]+|<description>[''^<]+'"' \""'$research_tmp/site-$i.xml" | sed -n '"'1,100p'
done"
